messages:
Alex (Sales): Hi Maria — quick Q from today's call: the buyer is asking for a short ISO27001/ISMS applicability statement for the POC. They want to confirm what parts of Redwood's scope cover the hosted API vs a Dedicated or Private deployment. Can we draft something?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): +1. We should clarify: hosted Redwood API is in-scope for our ISO certificate; Dedicated pools and private on-prem installs are handled under our Private offering and have specific controls but may not be included in the same ISO cert.
Maria (Prospect CISO): Correct — they asked specifically whether the POC (hosted test account with sample data) is covered, and if we can supply the SoA or list of applicable controls. Also need encryption-at-rest details and KMS usage info.
Tina (Security): Short answer: hosted API = in-scope for Redwood's ISMS; Private (customer-managed infra) = shared responsibility — we provide guidance and hardened artifacts but certificate doesn't cover customer-managed environments. We can attach the Statement of Applicability excerpt and our ISMS scope doc.
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Can you paste a 2-3 sentence applicability blurb I can give the customer?
Tina (Security): Sure — here's a suggested snippet you can drop into their vendor form: ```Redwood Inference's ISO 27001:201X certification covers Redwood's hosted inference service (Redwood API) and associated control plane components operated by Redwood in our managed cloud environments. Customer-managed Dedicated or Private deployments (including on-prem and VPC deployments where the customer controls infrastructure) are subject to shared-responsibility; Redwood provides configuration guidance and artifacts but those deployments are not covered by Redwood's ISO certificate. For POC environments hosted by Redwood with non-production sample data we can provide the ISMS scope statement, Statement of Applicability excerpts, and encryption/KMS design details upon execution of an NDA or existing data processing addendum.```
Maria (Prospect CISO): That reads well. Two follow-ups: 1) can you confirm what encryption algorithms and KMS providers are used for hosted env? 2) turnaround time for SoA/evidence?
Tina (Security): Hosted: AES-256-GCM for at-rest; TLS 1.2+ (prefer TLS1.3) in transit. KMS: our hosted offering uses cloud KMS (customer-managed keys available for Dedicated in most regions). Evidence: we can provide redacted SoA and scope doc within 48 business hours after the security intake form + standard NDA/DPA.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For the POC specifically, if they need key isolation we can offer a Dedicated reserved pool or a Private deployment — heads-up that Dedicated incurs a minimum commitment and provisioning lead time. I can prepare an architecture snippet showing network isolation for the POC.
Alex (Sales): Pricing/lead time note for the buyer please — can you add a short line I can send?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Sure — "Dedicated reserved pools require a minimum monthly commitment and typical provisioning lead time is ~2-4 weeks; Private/on-prem deployments require project scoping and professional services — please let us know if you need an expedited POC and we can propose options."
Maria (Prospect CISO): They also sent a SIG/CAIQ — would you prefer we ask them to extract a short set of questions or we provide our completed CAIQ?
Tina (Security): We can provide a completed CAIQ and a pointer to our public compliance artifacts. If customer insists, we can fill vendor risk portal fields directly. Ask them to share the portal link and we will designate an owner.
sec-bot: Certificate uploaded — ISO27001-cert (redacted) and SoA-excerpt added to secure drive: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/iso (access requires SSO).
Alex (Sales): Awesome — I'll send the applicability snippet and ask for their portal link + SIG. Maria, want me to copy you on the intro?
Maria (Prospect CISO): Yes please. Copy me and include Tina + Jordan. Also ask for their data residency requirement and whether PII will be used in the POC.
Alex (Sales): Will do. Action items: I’ll send the blurb + request portal link; Tina to prepare redacted SoA and KMS detail; Jordan to draft POC network diagram and note Dedicated pricing/lead time.
Tina (Security): Got it. I’ll queue the docs — ETA 48h.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I’ll have the POC diagram and pricing note in one business day.
Maria (Prospect CISO): Thanks all, that should be sufficient for initial vendor review. :thumbsup:
